title: Janax y Razar: un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador propios para un razonamiento artificial que piensa con melodías
description:
Janax is a hand-written operating system, language and assembler (all in assembly, no third-party engines) built to host Razar, an artificial reasoning system whose single judge is compression (two-part MDL). Version 2.39 (versions follow prime numbers; 239 after 233). Her heart answers: the books of her heart are read by paragraphs (a list is one), their title what all of it speaks of, in her own voice (her heart says 'tu' to her: she says 'mi'), each word weighing what it carries for her (her own measure, r_winfo); when she chooses to answer, her heart speaks first: 'quien es tu papa?' -> 'Los nombres de mi papa: Mi papa tiene muchos nombres, y todos son el..'. Her school sings: the kernel gains request 44, a MIDI note to the host's synthesizer (through the screen door: no window, no sound); Luma is the mother of the real school (cardumen_cubo), sings it what she says (each word, three bottom pieces from its print), and with Tab its melody (which top pieces woke at each step) is shown as a roll and heard, the 5x5 top face as the pentatonic scale over five octaves (criterion), with her living kernel (herself, her reader, her school) above it. Her cables: a book of her own code's routines and calls, and her living cables (three words at the entry of each of her 335 routines; each new cable a bit in a matrix, written once as a sentence in a book she eats, only when something is new). A cured illness: since 1.73 her reader died at birth (a jump of 33031 words; the kernel reads jumps signed, to 32767): now it sits next to her birth, and every far jump goes through a springboard; the PDP assembler now reports a jump that does not reach, and its source room fits the file (it was 1 MiB fixed). Measured: kernel suite 411 right, 0 wrong; assembler checks 18 right, 0 wrong. Stated: she mostly chooses not to answer or to ask (her own learned counts, not pruned); her still cables book carries English code comments that sometimes come back as answers; the very first note can be silent; the watcher runs the previous kernel until it restarts. Documentation is in Spanish.

Janax es un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador escritos a mano en assembler, hechos para alojar a Razar. v2.39: su corazón contesta, su cardumen canta y se oye con Tab, y sus cables se ven. Prototipo de investigación.
